intro.text: A statue in Thaylen City that stands near the temple of Battah.

description.text: It shows a human figure whose identity is unknown. It is so big that each of its parts takes several people to carry and ropes to haul up.

items.text: On Dalinar's first tour of Thaylen City, he saw that the statue had toppled from a ledge down into the Loft Wards, leaving only its feet. Queen Fen called it one of the city's sights before she noticed the damage.
After mending the temple of Talenelat, Dalinar went back with Fen's son Kdralk and ten men and healed the broken pieces back into one statue.
